args.reason: Only the `--dry-run` DoD item serves a declared goal. The other two DoD items add a persisted `.faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl` log and a `--explain` timeline with `--since` and `--format` filters. The first PRD goal says in terms that historical storage and query features are outside this PRD, so these items cover capability beyond the declared goals. This is gold-plating, not under-citation: no declared goal covers the extra DoD. The history log also writes on every real merge-gate evaluation, which widens the change past the inspection-only flag.
